taxonomy_evidence.rationale: The official list separately accepts L. californiae, L. multifasciata and L. zonata. L. zonata is distinct from existing ID5 L. californiae and not a subspecies or morph. No authority switching.

region_permissions.rationale: CDFW2019 revised distribution explicitly retains Sierra Nevada in L. zonata and excludes southern coast mountain lineage L. multifasciata. Yosemite primary ranger account confirms Sierra pine/oak woodland and rings. Constrain fictional subarea to forest/woodland rock cover, not bare alpine summit or all D05.

availability.interpretation: Nonexclusive authored warm-season activity subset. CDFW diurnal and crepuscular; Yosemite documents daytime spring and summer nocturnal shift. Do not state permanently daytime-only.

encounter.site_description: Quiet observation beside stable rocky woodland cover or rotting-log shelter; never move a log or pry permanent rock. New D05 site required.
encounter.numeric_values: Authored gameplay units, not real-world biological thresholds.
encounter.care: Keep distance and leave shelter untouched; no handling or provocation. Rock-return goal is not applicable to log/crevice sites.
